text:
maya: Quick check  SolaceHealth ready to sign after POC. They returned redlines on MSA/DPA, added Net60 and a customer-HSM ask. Need fast alignment: prepay vs Net60, POC SLA language, who can sign. cc @sara @liam

liam: Procurement: For a 2-week POC we usually require prepay or an approved PO. Net60 only after credit sign-off. Ask for remit address + tax ID on PO.

sara: Legal: I can carve a 1-page POC addendum today to: 1) scope audit to attestation only, 2) set data deletion 30 days post-POC, 3) mark HSM as production-only. That should neutralize their HSM redline for evaluation.

acct-bot: Finance flag: Net60 needs credit review. Approvals available: Net45 + 50% prepay for short trials. Send billing contact and W-9 to billing@redwood.example.

ben: SE: POC runs on dedicated infra, expect spikes during load tests (~50 rps). Can't commit to prod SLOs. Recommend "POC performance objective (non-binding): median latency target 150ms" and a short perf annex. I'll run a quick perf on Monday.

maya: Proposed package to customer: 1) POC addendum from Legal; 2) Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45; 3) SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) median 150ms; 4) E-sign accepted, Order Form must include PO# if issued. Any objections?

liam: Fine from procurement. We'll ask them to send PO to procurement@redwood.example and collect remit/tax info.

sara: I'll remove HSM requirement for POC and circulate addendum for quick approval.

ben: I'll post perf logs after Monday run; if median <150ms we can use that number.

maya: Action recap: @sara draft addendum; @ben perf Monday; @liam collect PO + W-9; finance approves Net45 + prepay. I'll own the e-sign envelope when ready.

maya: Order form snippet to send:
```
Term: POC (2 weeks)
Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 from invoice date
SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding)  median latency target 150ms
Data: Data deletion within 30 days after POC
```

maya: If anyone objects to prepay or the non-binding SLA flag now, otherwise I'll send to the customer and request PO + billing details.
